dashboard.label: TA-sensors Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype sensors:metrics); one series per chip-sensor metric, named sensors.*.

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-sensors requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-sensors", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-sensors/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: All sensors.* series (per sensor, per chip, per host in legend order)

search.query: | mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "sensors.*"

panel.title: Temperatures (°C - CPU cores, package, chipsets, PCIe, NVMe)

search.query: | mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*temp*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"
| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*fan*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"
| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*_in*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"

panel.title: Power draw (W - PSU rails, packages, GPU)

search.query: | mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*power*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"
| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*curr*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"
| mstats avg("sensors.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name="*hum*" | rename v* as "sensors.*"
| mcatalog values(metric_name) as m where index=metrics metric_name="sensors.*" | eval count=mvcount(m)

single.option: metrics registered on the metrics index
